scopeNotes.compilerCompatibility: The published pair is installed and built through @zeus-js/vite-plugin@0.0.6, which declares compiler-native@0.2.0-rc.5 — the same line the rc.5 packages use, so a consumer tree carries one compiler version and the plugin returns hmrPlan from transformModule({hmr:true}). The 0.0.5-era mismatch (compiler-native@0.1.1-beta.20 alongside 0.2.0-rc.5, and no hmrPlan) is resolved. CAVEAT: the evidence runs cited on this entry predate the 0.0.6 release; they describe the pair as it was verified then, not the current plugin. Re-verification with post-0.0.6 runs is outstanding, which is why scope.compilerCompatibility stays 'partial'.
